articles.title: From the Dux to the Strip: Inside Christchurch’s iconic pubs now gone
articles.summary: An individual, having studied at a specific building from 1971-73, considered leasing it in 1978 with a partner. Their ambitious plan was to convert the premises into a vegetarian restaurant, indicating a local entrepreneurial initiative focused on property transformation and hospitality. This narrative highlights a personal connection leading to a business venture.

articles.title: Trump says US considering 'winding down' Iran war as Tehran fires long-range missiles
articles.summary: Israel announced on March 21 that Iranian forces, for the first time, fired long-range missiles, escalating regional tensions. This unprecedented move significantly expands the potential reach of attacks beyond the Middle East, posing new security challenges internationally. The development underlines the volatile geopolitical landscape involving key players like the US.

articles.title: INS Taragiri, Navy’s latest stealth frigate, to be commissioned on April 3
articles.summary: INS Taragiri, the Indian Navy's advanced stealth frigate, is scheduled for commissioning on April 3. This induction significantly bolsters the Navy's combat capabilities and maritime security. As a modern stealth frigate, Taragiri features reduced detectability, highlighting India's growing indigenous shipbuilding prowess and commitment to naval modernization, which is crucial for power projection and defending national interests.

articles.title: The Dave Brubeck Quartet – At Carnegie Hall album art
articles.summary: "At Carnegie Hall" is a seminal jazz live album by the Dave Brubeck Quartet, recorded on February 22, 1963, at the iconic Carnegie Hall in New York City. This renowned recording captures the quartet's legendary performance, praised by critics like Thom Jurek, solidifying its historical significance in jazz music.

articles.title: Eid Mubarak: Salman Khan blows flying kisses; Salim Khan waves at fans as he makes first public appearance post-hospitalisation, Katrina Kaif likes Salman Khan's post
articles.summary: Bollywood superstar Salman Khan, joined by his father Salim Khan, celebrated Eid by making a special appearance on their Galaxy apartment balcony. This traditional gesture, considered an 'Eidi' (gift) to his admirers, added an extra layer of festivity to the occasion. Thousands of fans gathered to witness the interaction, making their Eid celebrations memorable with this annual celebrity greeting.

articles.title: Jaane Anjaane Hum Mile’s Bharat Ahlawwat on filming jail sequence with real ice slab; says “Skin turned red, mind went numb”
articles.summary: Actor Bharat Ahlawwat, from 'Jaane Anjaane Hum Miles,' revealed his challenging experience filming a jail sequence. He used a real ice slab, detailing how his skin turned red and his mind went numb from the cold. This glimpse into the demands of acting for television offers insight into the rigorous process of creating realistic scenes.
